profile_text.body:
Ouster, Inc. is a publicly traded company headquartered in San Francisco, California, trading under the ticker OUST and registered with the SEC under CIK 0001816581. Its website describes the company as a maker of digital lidar sensors, which it says are used in automation, drones, robotics, vehicles, and smart cities.

The site presents the sensors as a way to advance autonomy across those areas. It also quotes Matt Reiland, Technical Director of Automation Innovation at Komatsu, who says that products developed through a partnership between the two companies can withstand shock, vibration, and temperature constraints while delivering the range and spatial awareness needed to operate in harsh mining environments.

The record shows no lawsuits involving the company.
